name: Hallow's End Treats for Spoops!

angles.text: As a Horde traveler, you gather treats in the major cities and visit Sen'jin Village, the Darkspear settlement, on behalf of an ailing child.
As a Darkspear troll, you can find Kali Remik handing out seasonal sweets in Sen'jin Village during Hallow's End.

faq.answer: Spoops is a sick young person who cannot go trick-or-treating during Hallow's End. Hoping to take part, Spoops asks travelers to collect seasonal treats from innkeepers and vendors across the world.

aliases: why cant spoops go trick or treating
faq.answer: Spoops is too ill to go outside for Hallow's End. Bedridden by illness, Spoops relies on travelers to visit city innkeepers and gather holiday sweets.
Spoops offers magical candies that transform whoever eats them. They can turn you into shapes that are both funny and frightening.
faq.q: What candy does Spoops offer in exchange?

faq.answer: Innkeepers in the capital cities share holiday candy after travelers perform tricks. Kali Remik also hands out sweets in Sen'jin Village.
faq.q: Where do you find the treats for Spoops?

faq.answer: Kali Remik is a troll in Sen'jin Village, Durotar. During Hallow's End, Kali Remik gives holiday candy to travelers who stop by.
During Hallow's End, innkeepers in major settlements ask visitors to show their holiday spirit with silly tricks or gestures before sharing their sweets.
faq.q: Why do innkeepers ask for tricks?

sections.body: Spoops is too ill to join Hallow's End outdoors. While others celebrate, Spoops asks travelers to gather holiday treats. In return, Spoops offers candy that changes whoever eats it into strange shapes.
sections.title: A Bedridden Holiday

sections.body: Travelers can find holiday treats in settlements across the realm. Innkeepers in major cities ask visitors to perform tricks before sharing their sweets. Kali Remik also gives out treats in Sen'jin Village on the coast of Durotar.
sections.title: Tricks and Treats Across the Realm

summary: For Hallow's End Treats for Spoops!, an ailing child asks travelers to gather holiday sweets. Innkeepers in the cities and Kali Remik in Sen'jin Village share treats, and Spoops offers magical candy in return.
attribution: In-game quest text: Hallow's End Treats for Spoops!
